source.note: The release set the v0.2.20 shader legs ship (tools/shader/manifest.mjs loadReleaseSet at the pinned rev), in catalogOrder. A visual a rebuilt original overrides takes the original's header, palette, trailDecay and params and its post as the release set resolves it, and keeps the catalog's name, tier and calm flag; the paths map gives each manifest's SHA-256. Data only: the shader bytes are in glsl300/.

visuals.name: Pulse
visuals.header: // Pulse: A kinetic light installation: a field of glass orbs on winched wires re-forms into a new wave every eight beats while each beat rings a pulse through it, lifting and recolouring the orbs warm and cool in turn, over a mirror floor.

visuals.name: Starfield
visuals.header: // Starfield: A hyperspace jump; warp streaks stretch and shrink with the beat-locked speed through a streaming gas tunnel.

visuals.name: Crystal
visuals.header: // Crystal: a brilliant-cut gem in a lit studio, throwing rainbow caustics; fractures glow on transients.

visuals.name: Reactor
visuals.header: // Reactor: Slow orbit around a white-hot fusion core in a gimbal of containment rings, with spectrum arcs, heat shimmer, streaking sparks and a glowing chamber haze.

visuals.name: Chrome
visuals.header: // Chrome: Liquid-chrome bodies merging over a neon glass floor in a lit studio, mirroring the rig, the floor and each other.

visuals.name: Tunnel
visuals.header: // Tunnel: Flight down a curving tube of pleated, backlit paper, like the inside of a vast lantern: coloured light strips wind round outside and glow through the chevron folds, the dark lantern frame shows in silhouette, packets of light travel along the strips, pleat columns light with the spectrum and a hot packet races away behind the paper on each beat.

visuals.name: Terrain
visuals.header: // Terrain: A low flight down a canyon of glowing pillars whose depth rows rise with the spectrum.

visuals.name: Plasma
visuals.header: // Plasma: Smooth domain-warped plasma lit as a glossy relief over black: hot palette lobes outlined by clean complementary contour lines that creep outward and stream charge, a crisp discharge line sweeps the gas on each beat lighting the contours it crosses, and the gas runs hotter through bursts.

visuals.name: Dunes
visuals.header: // Dunes: Low sunset skim over sharp-crested dunes with heat haze and burning crests.

visuals.name: Cymatics/Prism
visuals.header: // Cymatics/Prism: A Chladni plate under a prism: quartz sand on a black vibrating plate gathers into a new nodal figure every eight beats, hopping off the antinodes with the spectrum, while a low raking beam split into a spectrum burns each ridge a different hue.

visuals.name: Spectral City
visuals.header: // Spectral City: A dawn flight above the clouds between glass spires whose light columns fill with the spectrum.

visuals.name: Waveform
visuals.header: // Waveform: A night drone light show over a city lake: a thousand drones draw the live waveform in rows of LEDs, re-forming every eight beats from a receding sheet of traces to a rolling tube to a wall of spectrum bars, mirrored as streaks in the rippled water under a sodium-lit skyline.

visuals.name: Bloom
visuals.header: // Bloom: a storm of backlit petals streaming from a giant flower of light toward the camera.

visuals.name: Drift
visuals.header: // Drift: Liquid-glass droplets drift over a crisp caustic pool in the dark, magnifying and splitting its light nets; a ripple ring runs out every bar; artwork becomes a low-frequency tint.

visuals.name: Vinyl
visuals.header: // Vinyl: Macro shot of a spinning record; spectrum-lit groove sheen, a beat light sweep and a sparking stylus over studio bokeh.

visuals.name: Ribbons
visuals.header: // Ribbons: A sheaf of foil ribbons in purple, hot pink, coral, gold and teal is cinched through a glowing gold ring and fans out to both edges; the ring is the key light, the foil shifts hue as each ribbon twists, the bass opens the ring and every beat the ring fires light packets outward along a new set of ribbons.

visuals.name: Ripple
visuals.header: // Ripple: High-speed drop photography in motion: a drop strikes a black mirror of liquid on every beat, splashing a crown and throwing up a jet that pinches off a bead, while the rings bend two coloured gels, a softbox and a string of spectrum lamps into bands of warm and cool.

visuals.name: Petals
visuals.header: // Petals: A huge flower held against a drifting lamp in a dark room, its petals each their own shape and lit from behind so the light glows through the tissue, picking out darker veins, a deep blotch at each base and lensing dew drops; the inner rings overlap like an iris, the rings slide against each other with parallax and lift as each beat's ring of light runs out, the shot reframes every eight beats and waves of loose petals tumble past out of focus.

visuals.name: Circuit
visuals.header: // Circuit: a fly-over of a glowing circuit-board city whose traces light up on the beat.

visuals.name: Spectrum
visuals.header: // Spectrum: A spectrum analyser as an endless row of glossy emissive glass columns on a mirror floor, backlit through haze, with floating peak caps, tracked by a slow camera.

visuals.name: Lattice
visuals.header: // Lattice: a flight through an endless braced crystal lattice where nested cymatic shells of prismatic light ripple through the struts.

visuals.name: Murmuration
visuals.header: // Murmuration: A vast starling flock folds and wheels across a blue-hour sky over a reed marsh, packing into dark fold bands where its sheet turns edge-on; a bass-driven banking wave rolls through it each bar, treble lights golden glints.

visuals.name: Ink
visuals.header: // Ink: Luminous ink in dark water: kicks launch warm plumes that mushroom upward, onsets burst dye open, treble draws a second cool ink in fraying wisps; the feedback buffer is the fluid.

visuals.name: Vault
visuals.header: // Vault: A projection-mapping show inside a night cathedral: graphic light mapped onto ribs, webbing and piers changes every two beats with a wipe down the nave, warm and cool swap each beat, a neon outline blazes in bursts and only the stained glass glows in breakdowns, all mirrored in the polished floor.

visuals.name: Loom
visuals.header: // Loom: A night glide down an endless loom: spectrum-lit warp threads rise through the shed to a fog-bright vanishing point, the shuttle lays hot weft that cools into twill, and heddle-wire bays along both sides glow as level meters.

visuals.name: Lens
visuals.header: // Lens: Sound as mass: three band-sized bodies bend a bright nebula, star field and spiral galaxies into arcs and Einstein rings as the field streams past; sustained energy inspirals them into one.

visuals.name: Photo Prism
visuals.header: // Photo Prism: A glass iris of turning wedge prisms splits the photo into dispersed copies around a clear lens and a circular waveform ring.

visuals.name: Memory Tunnel
visuals.header: // Memory Tunnel: A flight down a dark gallery hall of staggered backlit photo prints that develop from palette duotones into full colour as they approach, spilling light onto the walls, a polished mirror floor and drifting dust.

visuals.name: Photo Particles
visuals.header: // Photo Particles: The photo as a wall of glossy beads that dissolves and streams toward the camera as chromatic particles.

visuals.name: Photo Glass
visuals.header: // Photo Glass: Glass towers rise with the spectrum on a black mirror floor, refracting the photo behind them with prismatic fringes.

visuals.name: Photo Liquid
visuals.header: // Photo Liquid: Glossy liquid-glass drops slide over the melting photo, magnifying it, with caustics and neon ink veins.

visuals.name: Photo Topography
visuals.header: // Photo Topography: A dusk flight over relief raised from the photo, traced by glowing spectrum contour lines above a mirror lake.

visuals.name: Photo Lens
visuals.header: // Photo Lens: The photo folded into kaleidoscope shards inside a faceted crystal lens, with spectral dispersion, bokeh and glints.

visuals.name: Photo gallery
visuals.header: // Photo gallery: A tracking shot past floating holographic photo cards in a dark hall of fog and mirrored floor.

visuals.name: Photo Curtain
visuals.header: // Photo Curtain: The photo printed across a kinetic curtain of glossy vertical slats that twist in spectral waves, backlit through the gaps.

visuals.name: Photo Veil
visuals.header: // Photo Veil: The photo printed on billowing sheer silk in 3D, with glowing aurora chiffon veils hanging in the dark behind it.

visuals.name: Particles
visuals.header: // Particles: A rising vortex of embers round a molten light column above a black mirror floor; embers cool from gold to pink and cyan as they climb, each beat sends a white-hot ignition front up the swarm, and depth of field turns near and far embers into bokeh.

visuals.name: Kaleidoscope
visuals.header: // Kaleidoscope: a mirror tube of tumbling 3D glass pieces, flowing toward you.

visuals.name: Helix
visuals.header: // Helix: A flight down an avenue of double helices drawn in light over black, cyan and magenta backbones strung with beads and base-pair rungs that play the spectrum; each beat a wave of orange light runs down the helices, and streaks fly out of the vanishing point as the flight surges.

visuals.name: Rain
visuals.header: // Rain: A rain-soaked neon street at night: spectrum tubes, mirror puddles, splashing drops.

visuals.name: Constellation
visuals.header: // Constellation: Drifting through a deep star cluster; every beat draws new constellation lines between the stars, sparks racing ahead of them.

visuals.name: Comets
visuals.header: // Comets: A meteor storm over a dark planet's glowing limb: long motion-blurred streaks cross the whole frame at the speed of the music.

visuals.name: Glyph
visuals.header: // Glyph: Extruded spectral sigil of machined rings, backlit by its warm core in volumetric shafts against cool glowing inlays.

visuals.name: Nebula
visuals.header: // Nebula: A slow push through layered emission gas toward a blazing star-cluster core; ionisation rims, spectrum light shafts and spiked stars.

visuals.name: Aurora
visuals.header: // Aurora: Sky-filling aurora curtains mirrored in a mountain lake.

visuals.name: Phosphor Scope
visuals.header: // Phosphor Scope: Macro shot of a vector CRT: a beat-speed beam writes a tumbling 3D Lissajous figure that flashes cyan-white, then settles into an amber or violet afterglow that alternates with each new figure, with kick ripples in an accent colour, softbox glass reflections, halation and shallow depth of field.

visuals.name: Oscillo Ring
visuals.header: // Oscillo Ring: A long-exposure light-painting session in a wet concrete hall: a swung LED ring paints a lattice of spectrum-wobbled oscilloscope rings stroke by stroke, while two pixel sticks sweep twisting warm ribbons round it every two beats, steel-wool sparks bounce in the puddles and the painting alone lights the haze, floor and columns.

visuals.name: Seismograph
visuals.header: // Seismograph: a low flight over a landscape drawn in glowing seismic traces, where every beat sends a quake rippling through the lines.

visuals.name: Wave Cascade
visuals.header: // Wave Cascade: A live glass ribbon of the spectrum runs along the lip of a waterfall of falling light strands; each beat shears off a glossy sheet that tears into rivulets and settles on a mirror pool, and every bass hit sends a torrent plunging down the falls into a crown of spray, mist and a ring.

visuals.name: Strata Ridge
visuals.header: // Strata Ridge: Blue-hour mountain ranges stacked under a rising moon, each crest a glowing spectrum trace above mist-filled valleys.

visuals.name: Wave Tunnel
visuals.header: // Wave Tunnel: Flight through open space along a corridor of waveform rings: every ring is a slice of the trace with an echo trace and lit ribbon inside it, beads stream along the peaks, stars streak with speed through a violet nebula, onsets flare the nearest ring.

visuals.name: Interference
visuals.header: // Interference: Three orbs for bass, mid and treble hover over black liquid, each radiating its band's wavefronts; the rings interfere, catch the orbs' reflections and burn hot where crests align, while the camera circles the pool.

visuals.name: Filament
visuals.header: // Filament: A macro product shot of a showcase bulb: one coiled tungsten filament strung in a clear glass tube, its axis plucked by the music while its temperature runs from smouldering red to white-hot, with softbox highlights sliding over the glass and cool hexagonal bokeh behind.

visuals.name: Mirror Bloom
visuals.header: // Mirror Bloom: A kinetic facade of hinged chrome sequins over black felt whose mirrored tilt field draws petals, butterfly, twin spiral and iris figures that swell with the spectrum; each tilted disc flashes crisp slivers of coloured softboxes and point keys, beat waves catch a gold or teal ring light and treble scatters glitter.

visuals.name: Braid
visuals.header: // Braid: A flight down the inside of a woven sleeve of satin cords over black, a warm family and its cool cyan complement braiding over and under around the camera and trading the lead every four beats; light packets race along the fibres and each beat sends a cyan hoop down the tunnel.

visuals.name: Liquid Optics
visuals.header: // Liquid Optics: A macro shot through flowing liquid glass: a spectrum-lit neon ring and streaming ribbons bend into spectral loops, caustics and studio highlights; beats drop ripples.

visuals.name: Volumetric Light
visuals.header: // Volumetric Light: a slow dolly down a hazy hall where warm shafts from tall windows cross cold shafts from high round windows, and dust drifts through the beams.

visuals.name: Event Horizon
visuals.header: // Event Horizon: A slow orbit around a black hole whose lensed accretion disc wraps over and under its shadow; azure-and-crimson Doppler disc, orbiting hot spots, twin jets, photon ring, bent star field.

visuals.name: Prism Room
visuals.header: // Prism Room: a slow drift through a triangular mirror room that repeats as a receding kaleidoscope lattice, where a white beam strikes a glass prism and fans into a spectrum across walls of light bars.

visuals.name: Lumen Field
visuals.header: // Lumen Field: a low glide down a lamp-lit aisle through rows of glowing light stems under an aurora, over a wet mirror floor, with a ring of light racing out across the field on every beat.

visuals.name: Laser Tunnel
visuals.header: // Laser Tunnel: Flight down a hazed black-glass shaft rigged like a laser show: wall fixtures throw leaning, sweeping laser planes (smoky liquid-sky sheets in a warm family, cool beam fans) that scribe lines on the mirrored glass, re-patch every eight beats and chase fixture to fixture on the beat, on the shared cruise/build/burst/brake/drift speed profile.

visuals.name: Disco Floor
visuals.header: // Disco Floor: Neon-edged dancers sway their hips out on every beat and change moves every eight on an LED floor that changes colour, under a mirror ball that throws its spots across the room and moving heads that sweep coloured beams through the haze.
